ambiguities: Actual ChatGPT audible playback, host CSP behavior and local browser media events remain unverified as stated in the first Implement report; this revision changes only disclosure logic and its delivered UI test.
blockers: Host-dependent playback outcome still requires independent host observation.
change_summary: Tracked the selected playback source separately from the visible collection, so Radio Browser attribution stays hidden for NTS even after switching to Countries, remains visible for a selected country station while browsing NTS, and follows the ordinary catalog when no source is selected. Added delivered UI regressions for idle and playing NTS navigation and the return to country selection.
decisions: Selected source is country, nts, or null; tab visibility alone does not determine Radio Browser playback disclosure.
The no-selection Countries catalog retains its Radio Browser data attribution; browsing NTS without a country selection hides that disclosure.
tests: npm test on the revised candidate: PASS, 40/40 tests, including delivered bundle regression for NTS idle/playing with Countries tab navigation, no-selection catalog attribution, and selected-country disclosure while browsing NTS. Log: /tmp/dial010-revision-npm-test.log.
